description: SFLOW semi-implicit step with the coupled non-hydrostatic pressure (A 210 12, A 220 3) and a moving surface pressure (X 10 3, X 400 2: 8 x 2 m box with smooth ends, depth-Froude number 0.7, h = 1 m) in a 100 x 15 m channel with a symmetry wall at y = 0, dx = 0.5 m, dt = 0.1 s: the Kelvin wake with its dispersive transverse and divergent waves.
covers: X 10 3 2D with the semi-implicit coupled system
ship time step limit (one cell per step)
